sn16.12:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo āyasmā ca Sāriputto Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti Isipatane Migadāye || || 2
sn16.12:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Mahā-Kassapo tenupasaṅkami || pe || ||
sn16.12:1.3: vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantam Mahā-Kassapam etad avoca || ||
sn16.12:1.4: Kiṃ nu kho āvuso Kassapa hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā ti || ||
sn16.12:1.7: Kim panāvuso na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā ti || ||
sn16.12:1.8: Evam pi kho āvuso avyākataṃ Bhagavatā
sn16.12:1.10: Kiṃ nu kho āvuso hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato paraṃmaraṇā ti || ||
sn16.12:1.12: hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato paraṃmaraṇā ti || || 6
sn16.12:1.13: Kim panāvuso neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃmaraṇā ti || ||
sn16.12:1.14: Evam pi kho āvuso avyākataṃ Bhagavatā
sn16.12:1.15: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃmaraṇā ti || || 7
sn16.12:1.16: Kasmā cetam āvuso avyākataṃ Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn16.12:1.17: Na hetam āvuso atthasañhitam nādibrahmacāriyakaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbāṇāya saṃvattati ||
sn16.12:2.2: Idaṃ dukkhanti kho āvuso vyākataṃ Bhagavatā
sn16.12:2.5: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti vyākataṃ Bhagavatā ti || || 9
sn16.12:2.6: Kasmā cetaṃ āvuso byākataṃ Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn16.12:2.7: Etañhi āvuso atthasañhitam ādibrahmacariyakam etaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati ||
